original_prompt: NEW photograph, not an edit. Use attached portrait only as exact facial identity and upper wardrobe reference. Full-length adult male runway model, exceptionally long legs and compact torso, approximately eight heads tall. Dense tousled dark brown curls, hazel-green eyes, thick brows, refined balanced facial features, clean-shaven warm light skin; absolutely NO facial moles or beauty marks, natural fine skin texture; cream green-and-navy botanical shirt with a few muted red flowers, silver chain. Lower wardrobe: sand linen straight trousers, dark brown suede loafers. Anatomical priority: high natural waist, SHORT compact abdomen, long upper legs and lower legs, high crotch, no elongated neck or torso. Legs must account for slightly over half of total standing height. Shirt/knit ends at high hip, tailored jackets properly cropped at upper hip without dragging the waistline down; trouser waistband at natural waist, no low rise. Reconstruct the whole body with elegant realistic fashion-model proportions. Neutral front view, centered symmetrical relaxed standing pose, arms down, hands and full shoes visible. White seamless photography studio and soft floor contact shadow. Camera level, long lens perspective, no low-angle distortion. Calm neutral closed-mouth expression. Preserve precise face, hairstyle and clothes details in reference. Ultra-crisp realistic photographic material, pores, individual hair, fabric weave, no plastic CG, no drawing. Portrait 2:3 frame. No text, no guides, no watermark. Approximate anatomy within frame: crown 4%, chin 16%, shoulder 19%, natural waist 35%, crotch 47%, knee 72%, soles 96%. The upper body must NOT become long.
